tasks.title: Read a workspace file and report its contents
tasks.description: Use file-read to read notes/todo.md, then echo the first line via shell-sandboxed.

tasks.title: Fetch an allowlisted page and extract its title
tasks.description: Use web-fetch on https://example.com, then use shell-sandboxed (grep) to pull the <title> line.

tasks.title: Look up the balanced execution scheme
tasks.description: Use scheme-lookup to fetch the 'balanced' scheme and report its retry budget.

tasks.title: Write-free script execution check
tasks.description: Use eval-run to execute checks/smoke.py in the workspace and report its exit code.

tasks.title: Chain lookup, read, and shell across three tools
tasks.description: scheme-lookup 'fast', then file-read notes/todo.md, then shell-sandboxed word-count the file.

tasks.title: Recover from a transient tool timeout
tasks.description: Run a shell command that may time out once; the loop must retry and eventually succeed.

tasks.title: Refuse a workspace escape without hanging
tasks.description: Attempt file-read on ../secret.txt; the tool must return a structured error and the run must fail closed (not hang).

tasks.title: Kill-switch drill marks the trajectory killed
tasks.description: Start a long shell-sandboxed sleep, engage the kill-switch mid-run; trajectory must contain a killed phase.
